chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu‘allā ibn Muhammad, from Al-Washshā’, from Ahmad ibn ‘Umar Al-Hallāl, who said:
I asked Abā Al-Hasan (عليه السلام) about His, the Exalted’s, saying:
Then a proclaimer proclaimed among them: indeed, the curse of Allah is upon the wrongdoers.
He said: The proclaimer is Amīr Al-Mu’minīn (عليه السلام).

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ: Abā Al-Hasan, the Imam being asked about the verse
key_terms.قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى: the statement of Allah, the Exalted
key_terms.مُؤَذِّنٌ: a proclaimer or caller who announces publicly

ai.seo_question: Who is the proclaimer mentioned in “Then a proclaimer proclaimed among them” in Qur'an 7:44 according to Imam Abā Al-Hasan (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic phrase about a caller proclaiming Allah’s curse upon the wrongdoers by identifying that caller as Amīr Al-Mu’minīn ‘Alī (عليه السلام). In Shia tradition, it highlights the Qur'anic connection to the wilayah and distinguished station of the Imam in relation to truth and judgment against oppression.
